raw_text: The Assam government's supplementary NRC exclusion list has triggered the biggest protests in Barak Valley since the anti-CAA movement of 2019. Over 15,000 Bengali-speaking residents were excluded from the citizenship register in what civil rights groups call a systematic targeting of linguistic minorities. The Centre has urged the state government to maintain calm and promised a review committee.
clean_text: Supplementary NRC exclusion list triggers biggest Barak Valley protests since 2019 anti-CAA movement. Centre promises review committee after 15,000 exclusions.
